description: A dissociative dust that unplugs you from your own body for a while.

effects.comeon_message: You take the dust and wait, already feeling further away than you were.

events.text: [trip]The floor goes soft and the walls slide back. You start, very gently, to come loose from yourself.[/trip]
[trip]You slide a little further down the smooth grey funnel.[/trip]
[trip]Your body is somewhere behind you now, waving. You wave back, or think about it.[/trip]
[trip]Continents of thought drift past, too large and too slow to be afraid of.[/trip]
[trip]Someone is speaking. It might be you. It was a long time ago.[/trip]
[trip]The funnel widens, tips you out, and hands you back your arms and legs one at a time.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: Your body finishes its sentence without you. You are somewhere behind it now.

overdose.message: You go so far down the hole that you forget the way back, and your body forgets to breathe.

effects.take_line: You cut out a line of {name} and snort it.

withdrawal.message: The grey funnel calls. You keep glancing toward the door that isn't there.

stages.easing: A little room opens back up, on its own, without being asked for.
stages.onset: You are very definitely inside your own body and can feel where all of it is.
stages.peak: There is no distance left between you and any of it, and the funnel was distance, and it is closed.
stages.rising: Your own hands keep being yours. This has stopped being obvious and started being a fact you notice.
stages.tail: You are here. You keep checking the corner where the door used to not be.

name: k-hole
